options.autofish.title: XPlus Autofish Settings
options.autofish.enable.title: Enable Autofish
options.autofish.enable.title.tooltip: Toggles the entire mod on or off.
options.autofish.multirod.title: Enable MultiRod
options.autofish.multirod.title.tooltip: Cycles through all of the available rods in the hotbar, moving to the next as they break.
options.autofish.break_protection.title: Enable Break Protection
Stop using rods with low durability before they break.
options.autofish.open_water_detection.ti:
In game versions above 20w12a(1.16), You can only get treasure loot at open water.
This will alert you when you are not fishing at open water.
options.autofish.persistent.title: Enable Persistent Mode
options.autofish.persistent.title.toolti:
Enable this to always keep the fish hook cast whenever a rod is in hand.
Checks every 10 seconds and recasts if needed.
This is useful for lag issues or when fishing for long periods of time.
options.autofish.sound.title: Use Sound Detection
options.autofish.sound.title.tooltip:
§6Newer, more accurate detection based §6on bobber sounds rather than the §6standard hook movement detection.
- You must be somewhat close to the hook for this to work.
- If other players' hooks are near yours, it can falsely trigger a catch!
options.autofish.sound.title.tooltip.war: §cNote: this option only affects §cmultiplayer. Singleplayer uses its own §cdetection.
options.autofish.multiplayer_compat.titl:
Forces the use of multiplayer detection while in singleplayer.
This provides compatibility with third party mods.
options.autofish.recast_delay.title: Recast Delay (ms)
options.autofish.recast_delay.title.tool: Adjusts the delay between catching a fish and recasting the rod.
options.autofish.random_delay.title: Random Recast Delay Field
options.autofish.random_delay.title.tool:
Add ±% randomness to the Recast Delay For example: Set this to 20% will make a 1500ms delay fall in 1200-1800ms (1500ms ±20%).
Set this to 0 to disable this function.
options.autofish.reel_in_delay.title: Reel in delay
options.autofish.reel_in_delay.title.too:
Add a delay for the reel-in when a fish bites the float.
Set this option to 1 to disable this function.
options.autofish.clear_regex.title: ClearLag Chat Pattern
options.autofish.clear_regex.title.toolt:
Recast the fishing rod when this pattern is matched in chat.
§6This pattern is a §aRegular Expression§6.
options.autofish.basic.title: Basic Options
options.autofish.advanced.title: Advanced Options
options.autofish.auto_turn_view.title: Enable Auto Turn View
options.autofish.auto_turn_view.title.to: Automatically turn the camera view when a fish is caught.
options.autofish.arm_swing.title: Enable Arm Swing Animation
options.autofish.arm_swing.title.tooltip: Show the arm swing animation when automatically using the fishing rod.
options.autofish.turn_angle.title: Turn Angle
options.autofish.turn_angle.title.toolti: The angle in degrees to turn the camera when a fish is caught.
options.autofish.turn_duration.title: Turn Duration (ms)
options.autofish.turn_duration.title.too: How long to hold the turned view before restoring to original position.
info.autofish.open_water_detection.fail: §c[Autofish] The area you're fishing in is not open water!§0
options.autofish.guichecker.title: Disable Autofish in container GUI
options.autofish.guichecker.title.toolti:
Disable this mod when an container screen is set.
Detects chest, inventory, amongst other container GUI screens.
